data.name: Lioriel
data.gender_notes: Lioriel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'Lev' meaning heart and 'Ruah' meaning spirit, Lioriel means 'Light of the Godly Lioness'. This name has biblical relevance as it is reminiscent of the Lion of Judah, symbolizing strength, courage, and protection. The name Lioriel carries the meaning “Light, Godly Lioness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lioriel usually hope their child will grow to embody light, godly lioness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner courage, protection, and strength
data.etymology: Lioriel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Godly Lioness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lioriel total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_greek.name: Λιοριήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Λιοριήλ: Λίος (Light) καὶ ἄριστος (Best, most excellent). Πηγάζει από το Ἕβδομον (Hebrew) και εἶναι συνδυασμός λέξεων ἀπὸ τὴν Ἑβραϊκή θρησκεία, ἀκολουθώντας τὴν παράδοση τῶν Ἑβραίων. Ἀπὸ τὴν ἑρμηνεία τοῦ ὀνόματος, ἡ Λιοριήλ εἶναι ἡ μορφὴ τῆς ἀπωλείας τῶν ἀπαιτήσεων τοῦ κόσμου, ἀπελευθερώνοντας τὴν ψυχή μας ἀπὸ τὴν κοσμική ἡμωξία.

in_latin.name: Lioriel
in_latin.long_meaning: Lioriel: Lumen perfectum, ex Hebraico oriens, significat lux perfecta et claritas. In traditione Christiana, Lioriel est nomen quod significat claritatem mentis et spiritus, liberandam a mundi exigentia. Etymologia nominis oriens ex Hebraico verbo, Lioriel est forma nominis quae exprimit claritatem mentis et spiritus.

in_english.name: Lioriel
in_english.long_meaning: Lioriel: a name that signifies the perfect light and clarity of the mind and spirit, derived from the Hebrew word for 'light'. In Christian tradition, Lioriel is a name that represents the liberation of the mind and spirit from the demands of the world. The etymology of the name originates from the Hebrew word, Lioriel is a form of the name that expresses the clarity of the mind and spirit. It is associated with personality traits such as luminosity, wisdom, and spiritual illumination. In modern usage, Lioriel is a popular choice for Christian baby names, symbolizing the light of perfection and the perfect light of God.

data.cultural_impact: With its roots in the Hebrew language and biblical symbolism, Lioriel bears the richness of a heritage that is deeply rooted in an ancient yet influential culture. As a Christian name, Lioriel reflects the strong connection between biblical narrative and contemporary practices. By utilizing an ancient language and symbolic meaning, it offers those who bear the name a cultural connection to a profound history and a larger spiritual community.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of Lioriel lies in its rootedness in the Hebrew language and the New Testament concept of having a heart filled with faith and a spirit guided by the Holy Spirit. The ancient Hebrew name, Lioriel, signifies a godly woman who radiates light and strength. In Christian belief, she would be a woman whose heart is deeply rooted in faith and whose spirit is illuminated and empowered by the Holy Spirit. Lioriel offers a powerful message of inner fortitude and a faith that shines bright in an often challenging and uncertain world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lioriel: Light of God, radiant and divine. In the depths of darkness, Lioriel's name shines as a beacon of hope and grace.
